sampleItems.name: IFAK availability at HQ and in the field.

columns.title: Issue Description
columns.text: There is a need to have more than just a "boo boo kit" (i.e. band aides, etc) IMMEDIATELY available for our crews, especially install teams and staff that are working with power tools and on job sites.  "STOP THE BLEED" training is crucial and something I can provide a certified instructor.  IFAKs should be in all of our work trucks, and on job sites.  In addition, a bleeding control kit (tourniquets, etc) at a station at in our install dept.

columns.title: ROOT CAUSE
columns.text: No available equipment or training with staff as of yet.

columns.title: Solution Proposal
columns.text: Implement training on TQ's and IFAK equipment, AED, trauma first aide, bleeding control and purchase several IFAKS including TQ's.
